review_note: Retains Grothendieck existence under I-adically complete Noetherian A and separated finite-type X over S, restricted to coherent sheaves with supports proper over S. Formal target criterion is proper support of F1, not properness of X itself.
statement:
Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring complete with respect to an ideal $I$; set $S=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and let $f:X\to S$ be a separated finite-type morphism, and put $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X$.
Notation: for a Noetherian scheme $X$ and quasi-coherent ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subset\mathcal O_X$, $\textit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ is the category of inverse systems $(\mathcal E_n)_{n\geq1}$ of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules satisfying $\mathcal I^n\mathcal E_n=0$ and $\mathcal E_{n+1}/\mathcal I^n\mathcal E_{n+1}\cong\mathcal E_n$ via the transition maps; morphisms are compatible maps of systems. For any coherent $\mathcal E$, put $\mathcal E^\wedge=(\mathcal E/\mathcal I^n\mathcal E)_{n\geq1}$.
Let $\textit{Coh}_{\mathrm{proper}/S}(\mathcal O_X)$ denote coherent sheaves whose supports are proper over $S$, and let $\textit{Coh}_{\mathrm{proper}/S}(X,\mathcal I)$ denote objects $(\mathcal F_n)$ of $\textit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ for which $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_1)$ is proper over $S$.
Then The induced $I$-adic completion functor $\textit{Coh}_{\mathrm{proper}/S}(\mathcal O_X)\to\textit{Coh}_{\mathrm{proper}/S}(X,\mathcal I)$, $\mathcal F\mapsto(\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)_{n\geq1}$, is an equivalence of categories.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{theorem-grothendieck-existence}
\begin{reference}
\cite[III Theorem 5.1.5]{EGA}
\end{reference}
Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring complete with respect to an ideal $I$.
Let $X$ be a separated, finite type scheme over $A$. Then
the functor
(\ref{equation-completion-functor-proper-over-A})
$$
\textit{Coh}_{\text{support proper over }A}(\mathcal{O}_X)
\longrightarrow
\textit{Coh}_{\text{support proper over }A}(X, \mathcal{I})
$$
is an equivalence.
